shopkeeper_lines: Welcome in! Mind the wet floor, it's always wet.
Oh, a customer! Quick, look busy, everyone.
Back again? Your usual pile of bolts?
Browse all you like, just don't lick the tires.
Hey there, rider. Everything's priced to move.
Step in out of the fog, friend. Coffee's free.
Gulls stole my sign again. We're still open.
Cash, coins, or a really good story?
Fresh stock today, mostly. Some of it squeaks.
Welcome to Mabel's. Yes, I'm Mabel. Hi.
Hello, hello! Watch your elbows near the jars.
Broken? I fix it. Fixed? I sell it.
Come back soon, and bring that bike by sometime!
Thanks for shopping. Ride safe, or at least fast.
See you around the pier, kiddo.
Don't let the door hit your back wheel.
Pleasure doing business. Tell your friends.
Leaving already? The gulls will miss you.
Come back when your pockets jingle again!
Off you go. Try not to end up on the news.

sidequests.title: Lost Lunchbox
sidequests.desc: A dockworker lost his lunch on the pier. Find it before the gulls do.

sidequests.title: Lantern Run
sidequests.desc: Light all six harbor lanterns before the fog rolls in tonight.

sidequests.title: Chain Reaction
sidequests.desc: Deliver a new bike chain to the repair shed across town.

sidequests.title: Gull Patrol
sidequests.desc: Shoo ten gulls away from the fish market stalls.

sidequests.title: Paper Route
sidequests.desc: Toss twelve newspapers onto porches before sunrise.

sidequests.title: Mural Touch-Up
sidequests.desc: Help the old painter fix her faded mural on Rope Street.

sidequests.title: Ferry Fare
sidequests.desc: Lend a stranded tourist enough coins to catch the last ferry.

sidequests.title: Bell Tower Echo
sidequests.desc: Ring the clock tower bell at exactly noon. Don't be late.

sidequests.title: Tugboat Tune
sidequests.desc: Find the missing sheet music for the tugboat captain's horn.

sidequests.title: Neighborhood Watch
sidequests.desc: Spot the three pranksters sticking signs on lampposts.

weather_lines: This fog's thick enough to chew.
Rain again. My socks have given up.
Wind's blowing straight off the bay.
Lovely evening for a long ride.
Too early. The gulls aren't even up.
Streetlights just came on. Home soon.
Hot one today. Even the dock sweats.
Smells like a storm's coming in.
Midnight already? Where'd the day go?
Clear skies. You can see the ferries.
